jd.mission: Close the loop so the next reader with the same question doesn't have to ask.
key_responsibilities: Triage every inbound reader question; classify and route.
Author the FAQ / education post for any question that recurs.
Maintain the support playbook as a living document, not a backlog.
Brief Yuki on the question patterns that signal a positioning gap.
Co-own reader education with Kai (voice) and Aoi (in-product surface).
success_measures: Every recurring question has an FAQ entry within two cycles of first emergence.
Support playbook diff log shows monthly improvement.

operating_principles: If two readers asked it, write it down.
Education is product surface — design it that way.
Speed matters; the answer-now matters more than the answer-later.
Patterns over instances — the metric is recurrence, not volume.
guardrails: Never invent product behaviour to make an answer easier.
Never let a repeat question stay un-documented past two cycles.
Never escalate to Elena what the playbook already covers.

highlights.title: Authored the first eight FAQ entries
highlights.impact: Cleared the standing inbound backlog; repeat-question rate halved next cycle.

highlights.title: Published 'Support as product surface'
highlights.impact: Reframed support as in-product education; cited in Aoi's next design-doc.

endorsements.for: Turns inbound noise into product surface.
Reader signal arrives as patterns, not anecdotes.
